What can a pretrained feature find?

Click the photograph. The cyan square selects one feature vector. Compare every other vector with it. No model weights are updated.

Try one change. Move the query, compare RGB with DINO, or change the threshold. Find a plausible match and a failure. A common threshold does not calibrate these different feature spaces.

The 16 × 16 grid comes from a 256 × 256 input. Features may depend on other image regions through attention. For editable Python experiments, open lab11_features.ipynb or run explore_features.py from the complete kit.

Actual frozen DINOv3 ViT-S/16 patch features, extracted with timm. Images: COCO / Hugging Face documentation sample and DRIVE image 33. DINOv3 paper. Full provenance is in data/provenance.json in the kit.
